roles.policy: Approved home: thumb/index/middle/ring support when not driving or moving clear; little finger is free unless explicitly driving or moving. Prepared non-home fingers and animated non-driver fingers are retained. Wrist and palm anchors are always owned. Joint movement and contact-envelope evidence are stored per route.

contact_evidence.limitation: Bone-tip proximity is a conservative support candidate, not a mesh-contact proof.

boundary_notes: End wrist is in the rotated cube frame; after_hold must be interpreted with the global cube transform.
